explanation_full: The incremental feature analysis table tracks the performance metrics (R² and MSE) of various models (SVM, DT, RF, KNN, XGBoost) as the number of input features increases sequentially. For the KNN model, the R² score shows a clear upward trend, peaking at 0.8301 when 9 features are used (VFA -> Butyrate -> Acetate -> VSS -> Propionate -> Ethanol -> COD-O -> pH -> ORP_Low). The MSE score consistently decreases until this point, indicating optimal feature selection for KNN at 9 features. After 9 features, the R² score drops to 0.7305 and the MSE increases to 0.01888, suggesting that adding the 10th or 11th feature negatively impacts the model's performance.
